name: Progressive View-Dependent Color Baking
definition: A technique to alleviate memory bandwidth pressure from high-degree spherical harmonics by evaluating them progressively over multiple frames and writing results to a 'baked' view-dependent color buffer.
summary: Progressive View-Dependent Color Baking optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by evaluating high-degree spherical harmonics over multiple frames to reduce memory bandwidth pressure.
